Written in ROM order under `#pragma defer_codegen off`, which keeps D1 ahead of D0. None of the legacy shards carried a pragma.

The per-shard extern blocks are merged into one declaration per callee. Where shards disagreed on a callee's return type (func_02012694, _ZN5dCc_c6UpdateEv, Sound::PlayLong, cstd::atan2, dActor_c::ReflectAngle, PathPtr::GetNode) the TU keeps one spelling; every caller reproduces with it.
func_ov100_02141fb0 reaches slot 29 as ((daIbl_c *)c)->OnAimedAtWithEgg() instead of the legacy shard's 30-slot shadow vtable; the bytes and the relocation destinations are unchanged.
func_ov100_02142264 copies its matrices through a twelve-word array struct; the C++ Matrix4x3 copy is the struct-copy DIFF described in notes/cpp-class-form.md.
func_ov100_021424c0 and func_ov100_02142b90 were C shards; they compile as C++ here, and func_ov100_02142b90's stack vector is a plain three-word struct so it carries no destructor.
InitResources (complete=False in the old delinks) matches inside the TU: 0x38c for 0x38c, through the `(u32)param1 >> 4` cast lever its legacy source already carried.

daIbl_c_classInit is written as `return new daIbl_c;`: the implicit constructor reproduces the loose file's fBase_c::operator new(0x3fc), dEnemyBase_c base constructor, vptr store and the five member constructors byte for byte.

compiler_only_output.reason: Homeless. One out-of-line destructor under #pragma defer_codegen off emits D1, D0, then D2. The cartridge has D1 at ov100:0x02141f04 and D0 at 0x02141f4c and no D2. Production isolation discards it. It is emitted after D0, and the licensed functions stay ROM-ascending.

include/types.h defines Vector3::~Vector3() inline and empty. Several helpers take Vector3 locals, so this TU emits that four-byte body once as vague linkage. The cartridge's copy is arm9:0x020072c0 (src/named/arm9/_ZN7Vector3D1Ev.cpp); this object is not its home.

This class's __si_class_type_info, dragged in with the vtable. Cartridge copy ov100:0x02147f4c. Its base word is _ZTI12dEnemyBase_c.
